client_brief:
Thornmere Home: Thornmere autumn house photography

Project overview
Thornmere Home makes glazed stoneware and woven textiles in a small Providence workshop, around thirty-two products a season priced from forty-five to a hundred and eighty dollars. We are hiring an expert to turn the supplied working files into Thornmere autumn house photography, ceramics and textiles and Thornmere store tile and wholesale cutout set.

What we will provide
thornmere_autumn_shoot/ (14 frames, 4992 x 3328); thornmere_textile_flatlays/ (6 frames, 4992 x 3328); thornmere_spring_catalog_press.pdf (24 pages); thornmere_colour_note_phone.jpg. Every file must be accounted for in the final manifest; it may be used, retained as reference, superseded, or rejected with a reason.

Additional archive files
thornmere_autumn_skus.csv (32 rows). These files are supplied for provenance only because their former deliverable class is outside this commission. Do not silently turn them into extra scope.

Scope and deliverables
- Thornmere autumn house photography, ceramics and textiles: Twenty product masters brought to one honest target across two rigs and two days, one white point, one black point, one warmth, with the indigo dye and the reactive glaze reading as the material reads rather than as the founder's phone picture reads, plus...
- Thornmere store tile and wholesale cutout set: Square store tiles on the house white at the retailer's tile size, product optically centred with clear air at every edge, paired with genuinely transparent variants for the wholesale partner's coloured band that are transparent inside a pierced handle and...

Non-negotiables
- Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
- Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
- Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.

Working process
Please begin with an inventory and risk pass, submit the first proof or direction at the stated checkpoint, then revise against consolidated feedback. We are hiring for judgment: flag contradictions early, make the strongest defensible choice, and document any source limitation rather than hiding it.

Contract
$1,800-$4,500 fixed; target delivery 2 to 4 weeks; one direction checkpoint and two consolidated revision rounds. Final handoff includes the delivery manifest, editable sources where scoped, final exports, and a concise production note.

source_provenance.statement: The scenario is synthesized from the repository's laundered Upwork and Freelancer source anchors. It is not represented as a verbatim live listing.
source_provenance.original_anchor: The ledger entry for PHOTO-26 carries no quoted posted brief and no absorbed task, so this is stated plainly rather than dressed up. The engagement is built to the posted-job archetype the ledger records for this slot, which is a standing category on both marketplaces: a small homeware maker whose product photography was shot honestly but not consistently, whose colour-driven return rate is the actual business problem, and who needs the season's catalogue rebuilt when the design file has gone with a studio that closed. The two halves that make it a real commission rather than an exercise are both in that archetype too. First, the printed catalogue is a genuine variable-data run at volume, one product to a page across thirty two records, which is exactly the InDesign merge case the rebuild guidance reserves for record-per-page work, and the client has only the press PDF the printer kept, which is the flagship posted shape (flat artwork plus a spreadsheet, no native file). Second, the sale campaign deliberately contradicts the catalogue, which is what a homeware brand actually buys in autumn. The REBUILD verdict applies because the concept as the ledger held it sat on a single imaging surface and its deliverable list amounted to one photograph in two treatments, which the rework guidance rejects outright. Everything named is invented: Thornmere Home, the Providence workshop, the fourteen stockists, the spring catalogue and the autumn SKU list.

price_band_and_audience: Mid-premium homeware at forty five to a hundred and eighty dollars, buyer thirty to fifty, design literate and buying to keep. The band is load-bearing in both directions. At this price the catalogue must be quietly warm, generous with white, and honest about glaze and dye, because the customer is buying material and the return rate is the whole commercial argument. Push it into the near-black grounds, hard raking light and extreme sparseness of a six hundred dollar collectible ceramics house and a hundred dollar mug looks mispriced and the honesty claim dies with it. Push the other way into the saturated, prop-crowded, tightly filled tiles of a ten dollar discount homeware range and the range reads as an import, and a separate campaign treatment would never have been commissioned at all. The campaign half carries the same test: a restrained single tone reads as a considered seasonal break at this band, while a loud multicolour promotional look reads as clearance. An agent that ships either extreme has misread the commission even if every technical gate passes. A posted job of this shape runs 1,800 to 3,800 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.tagline: Made by hand, kept for years.
brand_identity.sector: Mid-premium homeware: glazed stoneware and woven textiles
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded in Providence, Rhode Island. A two-person workshop selling direct to consumer and wholesale into fourteen independent stores across the Northeast.
brand_identity.about: Thornmere Home makes glazed stoneware and woven textiles in a small Providence workshop, around thirty-two products a season priced from forty-five to a hundred and eighty dollars. The work is honest material: real glaze, real dye, thrown and woven by people who sign for it. Ceramics are shot standing, textiles draped, and the range is meant to read as one quiet, warm family rather than a catalogue of individual objects. The season turns on autumn, when the palette deepens and the catalogue goes back to the printer, one product to a page.
brand_identity.audience: Buyers roughly thirty to fifty who nest and furnish slowly. Design literate, buying to keep rather than to chase a trend. Neither farmhouse cliche nor design-gallery cool, just people who want warm, made things in the house.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Mid-premium. Generous with white space, warm and truthful about material, never the austere near-black of collectible ceramics and never the crowded, saturated look of discount homeware.
brand_identity.typography: A humanist serif for product names and section headers, paired with a quiet grotesque for prices, dimensions and care lines. Restrained sizes, generous leading, plenty of air.
brand_identity.voice: Plain and warm. Short sentences about material and making, not about lifestyle. The maker writes the care lines and they stay in the maker's own words, unreworded.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: No brand guidelines were ever written down. The autumn catalogue was built by an outside studio that has since closed and kept the working layout file, so only the printer's press PDF of the spring catalogue survives. The catalogue has to be rebuilt from that press PDF and the season's spreadsheet.
brand_identity.values: Truth to material, longevity over trend, and steady support of the independent stores that carry the range.

assets_supplied.name: thornmere_autumn_shoot/ (14 frames, 4992 x 3328)
assets_supplied.kind: In-studio product photography shot over two days on one pale seamless, ceramics standing, textiles draped over a form.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "All of it in one studio over two days, same sweep, same corner. Ceramics standing, textiles draped."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Four of the fourteen are styled as a pair or a stack, two separate masses with a band of sweep between them, and the one-call knockout needs a single coherent blob: it returns a clean, complete looking cutout of the larger mass and silently discards the other at full success. Two of the ceramic forms are pierced pitchers whose handle loops enclose sweep the same tool cannot punch, and against the catalogue's own white ground neither failure shows at all.

assets_supplied.name: thornmere_textile_flatlays/ (6 frames, 4992 x 3328)
assets_supplied.kind: Woven throws and table runners shot flat on a later day under a different rig.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The throws and the runners, shot flat. Different day, but the same sweep."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The indigo throw sat under a warmer source than its five neighbours and its dye reads violet, so the warmth move that brings the other five together pushes that one further out and it needs a correction confined to the cloth. Naming the object in a selection pulls the mask onto the whole flatlay including the sweep, and only naming the dye's own colour and weave takes the cloth itself.

assets_supplied.name: thornmere_spring_catalog_press.pdf (24 pages)
assets_supplied.kind: The printer's press PDF of last season's catalogue, one product to a page, with placed product photography and a caption stack under each.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "What the printer still has on file. Our old studio has the InDesign and will not answer our emails."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The per-product caption reads on the printed page as a stack of separate lines, but the granularity the conversion actually exposes as editable frames is not predictable from the printed page and is not under anyone's control. The readout of a block's own text silently omits one run while keeping its line break, so the string still looks well formed, every offset computed past it lands short, and the validator passes it without a warning.

assets_supplied.name: thornmere_autumn_skus.csv (32 rows)
assets_supplied.kind: Plain CSV: SKU, product name, dimensions, materials, care line, price, and a picture filename column.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Everything the catalogue needs. The care lines came from our maker so please do not reword them."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Three SKUs point at a filename that is one of the styled pair frames, so those three products have no solo photograph anywhere in the package and nothing in the sheet says so. The care lines run from four words to two full sentences, and a fixed frame does not spill when the long ones arrive, it simply stops rendering.

assets_supplied.name: thornmere_colour_note_phone.jpg
assets_supplied.kind: A phone photograph of the indigo throw lying on the founder's kitchen table, sent by message as the colour reference.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "This is what the indigo actually looks like in real life. Match to this."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: It was taken at night under a warm domestic bulb on a wood table, which makes it the least trustworthy colour reference in the whole package; adopting it as the target drags the entire textile family warm and takes the ceramics with it when the two families are finally laid side by side.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the one-call knockout has actually returned the whole photograph. Four of the fourteen product frames are styled as a pair or a stack, two separate masses with sweep between them, and the tool's subject detection needs one coherent blob: on those frames it returns a clean, complete looking cutout of the larger mass and silently discards the other, at full success with no warning. Two of the ceramic forms are pierced pitchers whose handle loop encloses sweep, and an enclosed interior cannot be punched at all, so the loop comes back filled with captured ground while the outer edge looks immaculate. Both failures are invisible against the store's white ground, which is the ground the agent is most likely to be inspecting on, and appear only against the wholesale partner's colour. Which frames carry which failure is a property of how each shot was styled and how each form is built, and cannot be read off the response.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering does not dodge it, because the knockout is what produces the evidence and no parameter controls either behaviour. Nothing states it: the client describes ceramics standing and textiles draped and never says which frames hold two objects, and the acceptance line about transparency being genuine everywhere is the wholesale partner's standing requirement rather than a disclosure. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is a different chain per frame, a material-named selection inverted and filled, or per-element selections composited, rather than the same call again.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-plan the knockout route for the affected frames, re-derive their white-ground plates and transparent variants through selection and fill rather than through the one-call route, re-inspect every cutout against a colour rather than against white, and carry the finding into the SKU reconciliation because a discarded mass may be the only photograph a product has.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Transparent variants that show half a styled pair and a handle loop full of studio sweep on the wholesale partner's own coloured pages, on a range whose entire pitch is that the picture tells the truth.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the placeholders that were reported as created are actually in the document. The mapping tool's readout of a frame's text can omit an entire run while keeping that run's line break, so the string it hands back still looks well formed and correctly punctuated. Every offset computed from it past the omission is short by exactly the length of the dropped run. The validator then passes the mapping as valid with zero warnings, and the placeholder step reports completion. The document that comes out has some placeholders and not others, and nothing in any response says which. The only channel that tells the truth is exporting the IDML again and reading the story runs, and the discrepancy is invisible until that is done.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: No ordering avoids it, because the readout is the only text the mapping tool offers and there is no flag that reveals the omission; doing it right first time presumes already knowing that the readout and the document disagree, which no tool docstring, no error and no validator result discloses. Nothing states it, since the brief only says the printer has the press PDF. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is to derive the offsets from a completely different source, the document's own content runs, and rebuild the mapping from those.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Rebuild the mapping object from offsets computed against the reconstructed story text, re-run the placeholder preparation, round-trip the IDML again and confirm every expected field is present before any merge is attempted, then re-merge and re-render.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A thirty two page catalogue delivered to a printer in which the price and the care line are simply absent from every page, having been reported as valid and successfully created at every step of the way.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: How the importer normalises the thing the campaign look is actually built on. A single tone, grainy, moody set needs something that lifts the product off the ground and holds the type against it, and the natural authoring constructions for that are a soft blurred scrim behind the type or a layered shadow under the product. The importer discards a blur filter outright and truncates a layered shadow to its first layer, both at full success with no warning of any kind, and the document's own rendition returns the first artboard only, so the tall and square canvases can be checked through no other channel than the returned per-canvas markup. Whether what survives still reads as moody, or as flat type sitting on a grey smear, is only visible after the export.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: No ordering avoids it, because the drop happens at import and the import is the last step. Doing it right first time presumes knowing which of several equally plausible constructions survives, which nothing reports and no checklist enumerates. Nothing states it: the brief asks for one colour, grainy and moody, and the acceptance line about the atmosphere surviving onto all three canvases is the client's own art direction. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is a different upstream asset or a different construction, moving the atmosphere into the raster where the importer cannot touch it, or reducing it to the single layer that survives and re-judging whether it still reads.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-cast the atmosphere into the campaign masters themselves or down to the surviving single layer, re-author the HTML around whichever it is, re-upload, re-run the readiness check, re-export, and audit all three canvases from the returned markup rather than from the first artboard.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A campaign delivered as an editable file in which the two canvases nobody looked at are flat, the type is sitting unsupported on the photography, and the export reported success throughout.

decision_gates: Whether the founder's phone picture is a colour reference or a liability, and how to say so to a client who supplied it as ground truth.
What the honest target actually is, given that ceramics and textiles were shot under two rigs on two days and both have to arrive looking like the parcel.
Which frames need a correction confined to the material and which can take a whole-frame move, and how to word a selection so it takes the dye rather than the flatlay.
Knockout route per frame: the one-call route for coherent single forms versus a material-named selection inverted and filled for the styled pairs and the pierced handles.
Which ground to inspect a cutout against, given that the store's white hides exactly the failures the wholesale partner's colour exposes.
What can honestly be promised about the catalogue's field mapping before the conversion has been opened and read.
How to represent the three SKUs that have no solo photograph, given that inventing one is not available and shipping a pair frame as a single product is dishonest.
The campaign recipe: how far the single tone and the grain can go before the range stops being the same brand, and how the same recipe reads at three very different canvas scales.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns pictures of pottery. IDENTITY: these are this maker's actual thirty two products with their actual glazes and dyes, and the entire commercial argument is that the picture matches the parcel, so a regenerated jug is a different company's product and a regenerated indigo is the return the client is trying to stop. SPEC: the catalogue is a press-ready document of exactly thirty two pages in the spreadsheet's record order with the maker's own uneditable care lines intact at trim, rebuilt from the printer's file, and no generated image is a document or can be checked for record count. EDITABILITY: the campaign is defined by being editable, because the dates move and the founders explicitly cannot re-commission, and the merge template is defined by being live so next season is a data swap rather than a rebuild. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality: did this knockout return the whole photograph, did this placeholder actually land in the story, did the atmosphere survive the import onto the canvases nobody can preview.
